chain.label: Cirrus had not performed a system safety assessment for excessive fuel flow during takeoff/climb
chain.trigger: a lack of system safety assessments to identify the cause and reduce the potential of the hazard from occurring

chain.label: Fuel pump switch selected/repositioned to HIGH BOOST/PRIME during takeoff climb instead of required BOOST position
chain.trigger: suspected incorrect selection of the fuel pump's HIGH BOOST/PRIME position caused the excessive fuel flow

chain.label: Slope controller improperly adjusted, allowing manifold pressure above the specified limit
chain.trigger: the excessively high fuel flow...experienced during the accident was likely caused by an improperly adjusted slope controller

chain.label: Excessive fuel flow delivered to engine during takeoff climb (42.2-50.1 gph, exceeding manufacturer parameters)

caused_by.evidence: a lack of system safety assessments to identify the cause and reduce the potential of the hazard from occurring
the electric fuel pump could deliver 19 gph (in the BOOST position) to 42 gph (in the HIGH BOOST/PRIME position)

chain.label: Loss of engine power during takeoff climb

caused_by.evidence: excessive fuel flow was determined to be the cause for the engine failures in all six accidents
